name: overflowgo
description: Demand-driven overflow reporting and dispatch layer for municipal garbage collection.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @overflowgo/api && npm run build -w @overflowgo/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @overflowgo/shared && npm run typecheck -w @overflowgo/api && npm run typecheck -w @overflowgo/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @overflowgo/api && npm run test -w @overflowgo/web
